title: 第2418章 围攻舒穆第2417章 轮回往生了再战
lines: 逆天改命。
这轮回转生，在某种程度上便是逆天改命，而且，是能够控制的逆天改命，可以拥有过去不敢想象的天赋潜能。
谢诗莹他们，都是重新走上了转世轮回，这一世的他们，不管长成什么样子，但天赋潜能都是最高的一等！
而且，是完全针对自身大道而设计的天赋，能够让他们在各自的领域达到更高成就！
这增幅，可绝对不小。
此刻众人联手，全部攻向舒穆。
舒穆蹙眉，他当然感受到了压力，不过，最大的压力还是源自骆雨棠，只要能够制住骆雨棠，那么在舒穆看来，谢诗莹等人即便变得更强，威胁也是十分有限。
毕竟彼此之间的差距，实在是太大了！
“大黑，去！”
却是超级无敌大美女最强的上位血脉继承纪家血脉最强力量的纪颜，低喝一声。
而一条血脉至纯至正的古老蛟龙则是怒吼一声，猛地向着舒穆撕咬而去，龙威浩荡，那巨大的龙首张开，一口龙之吐息落下，便是极致的破坏力！
“古龙种！”舒穆脸色一沉。
古龙种三个字，就已经代表了强大，而这古蛟龙明显还是其中的佼佼者，此刻一口吐息向他冲来，所过之处一切都被破坏，就是舒穆，都有些头皮发麻！
好恐怖的力量，不愧是古龙种。
即便是舒穆，面对这样的攻击也不敢小觑，单手压向前去，无边大势被他单手推动，古蛟龙的龙之吐息，被他死死抵挡。
到底是无上九圣天，即便身处劣势，却依旧拥有绝对性的表现。
“你有多少能耐，也敢对我出手，今日便废了你！”一声娇喝响起，却是纪颜已经喝了酒。
轮回重生之后，这喝酒如同变身的特性，反而被进一步的加强了。
此刻喝酒的纪颜，浑身散发着冷意，即便是看向舒穆的眼神，竟然也是居高临下一般的轻蔑，自然完全没有畏惧。
纪颜出手，剑光斩动天地，一剑如同破裂天地的光，可直接令无尽的神山大川都从中间被斩断。
而且，一种难以言喻的伟力加持在这一剑之上，任何天神在这一剑面前，竟然有天生被压制之感，战力的发挥都会受到限制！
纪家的丫头，哪来这样的力量！
舒穆挡下了所有人的攻击，以必中追击骆雨棠，而此刻，他已经有些分身乏术。
谢诗莹他们的攻击对他来说看似无法造成什么影响，但那是他能够完全应对的情况，如今这种情况，他已经有双拳难敌四手之感！
甚至纪颜的那一剑，竟然都让他感受到了恐惧。
虽然只有那么一点点，但足以说明问题。
这个纪颜很特殊，其力量可不是纪家的传承能够解释。
而这到底是何种力量，舒穆竟也不清楚，但毫无疑问，这跟他们天神的本源有关系。
纪家的丫头，没想到藏得这么深！
纪颜的身体曾经被净土所改造，自然不是等闲可比，就算是同为无上的世家，但在同一辈之中，真正能够胜过纪颜的，不超一手之数。
即便他们现在更强，但未来的某一天，纪颜势必可以后来居上，斩灭一切敌手。
纪颜自身虽然没兴趣，但醉酒纪颜却是对问鼎天下有着极高的兴趣，纪家接下来将进一步没落还是触底反弹，可能就都看他们这对兄妹了！
只不过，那也得等到后期才行。
现在的纪颜，还是太稚嫩了一些，即便醉酒的状态，这一剑可以说是没有破绽，但，力量终究不足。
换做平日，舒穆弹指便可破掉纪颜这一剑。
但现在，他也破解得有些勉强，很显然，他压力也不小，并没有表面上看的那般轻松。
挡下纪颜的攻击，舒穆想要即刻反击，但却没有那么容易。
只是纪颜他们想要更进一步取得战果，却也没有做到。
无上九圣天的力量，还是太过权威了，众人一时之间也拿之不下！
但时间，是在舒穆这一边的。
舒穆化解了所有人的围攻之后，便是更进一步的激发身上的力量，他本就不求速胜，只要能够支撑下来，那么他的胜算自然加大。
content_en:
Change your fate against the will of heaven.
This reincarnation is, to a certain extent, a change of fate that goes against the will of heaven. Moreover, it is a change of fate that can be controlled. It allows one to possess talents and potentials that were unimaginable in the past.
Xie Shiying and the others have all embarked on the cycle of reincarnation again. No matter what they look like in this life, their talents and potentials are the highest!
Moreover, they are talents designed completely for their own path, allowing them to achieve higher achievements in their respective fields!
This increase is definitely not small.
At this moment, everyone joined forces and attacked Shu Mu.
Shu Mu frowned, of course he felt the pressure, but the biggest pressure still came from Luo Yutang. As long as Luo Yutang could be controlled, in Shu Mu's view, even if Xie Shiying and others became stronger, the threat would be very limited.
After all, the gap between them is really too big!
"Dahei, go!"
But it was Ji Yan, the most powerful high-ranking bloodline of the super invincible beauty who inherited the most powerful bloodline of the Ji family, let out a low drink.
And an ancient dragon with pure and upright blood roared and fiercely tore towards Shu Mu. The dragon's power was mighty, the huge dragon's head opened, and a dragon's breath fell, which was the ultimate destructive power!
"Ancient dragon species!" Shu Mu's face darkened.
The three words "ancient dragon" already represent power, and this ancient dragon is obviously the best among them. At this moment, it rushed towards him with a breath, everything in its path was destroyed, even Shu Mu's scalp was numb!
What a terrifying power, worthy of being an ancient dragon species.
Even Shu Mu did not dare to underestimate such an attack. He pressed forward with one hand, pushing the boundless momentum with one hand, and resisted the dragon's breath of the ancient dragon.
After all, it is the Supreme Nine Holy Heavens. Even though they are at a disadvantage, they still have absolute performance.
"You have so many abilities, but you still dare to attack me. Today I will destroy you!" A voice shouted, but it was Ji Yan who had already drank.
After reincarnation, the characteristic of drinking like a transformation has been further strengthened.
Ji Yan, who was drinking at the moment, was exuding coldness. Even when she looked at Shu Mu, her eyes were filled with condescending contempt. Naturally, she had no fear at all.
Ji Yan took action, and the sword light slashed the heaven and earth. One sword was like the light that broke the heaven and the earth, and could directly cut off the endless sacred mountains and rivers from the middle.
Moreover, an indescribable power is blessed on this sword. Any god in front of this sword will feel inherently suppressed, and the performance of his combat power will be restricted!
How could a girl from the Ji family have such strength?
Shu Mu blocked everyone's attacks and pursued Luo Yutang with certainty, but at this moment, he was already a little overwhelmed.
Xie Shiying's attacks seemed to have no impact on him, but that was a situation that he could fully cope with. Now in this situation, he already feels that he is unable to defeat him with two fists and four hands!
Even Ji Yan's sword actually made him feel fear.
Although it is only a little bit, it is enough to explain the problem.
This Ji Yan is very special, and its power cannot be explained by the inheritance of the Ji family.
Shu Mu actually didn't know what kind of power this was, but there was no doubt that it was related to the origin of their gods.
The girl from the Ji family didn’t expect to hide it so deeply!
Ji Yan's body has been transformed by the Pure Land, so it is naturally not comparable. Even if they are from the same supreme family, among the same generation, there are only a handful of people who can truly defeat Ji Yan.
Even though they are stronger now, one day in the future, Ji Yan will definitely be able to catch up and destroy all opponents.
Although Ji Yan himself has no interest, drunk Ji Yan is extremely interested in winning the world. Whether the Ji family will further decline or bottom out may all depend on these two siblings!
However, that will have to wait until later.
The current Ji Yan is still too immature. Even in a drunken state, this sword can be said to have no flaws, but the power is still insufficient.
Normally, Shu Mu could break Ji Yan's sword with just a snap of his fingers.
But now, he is also struggling to crack it. Obviously, he is under a lot of pressure and is not as relaxed as he seems on the surface.
After blocking Ji Yan's attack, Shu Mu wanted to counterattack immediately, but it was not that easy.
It's just that Ji Yan and the others wanted to go further and achieve results, but they failed to do so.
The power of the Supreme Nine Holy Heavens is still too authoritative, and no one can grasp it for a while!
But time is on Shu Mu's side.
After Shu Mu defused everyone's siege, he further stimulated his strength. He did not seek a quick victory. As long as he could sustain it, his chances of winning would naturally increase.
title_en: Chapter 2418 Besieging Shu Mu Chapter 2417 Fight again after reincarnation
